notes: Phase A closes the residual code gaps from the 2026-08-15 external audit; Phase B qualifies the result against real infrastructure (Hetzner Cloud, project 'clink', cost-capped). A campaign is not done until its page is on the site.

items.title: HttpServer::stop() waits for the listen loop before stopping it (watch item 64)
evidence: tests/test_http_auth.cpp HttpLifecycle.ImmediateStopAfterStartNeverWedges: ~550ms with the fix across 3 runs; mutant (wait_until_ready removed) wedges within 90s, verified by disassembly of both binaries
core label green post-fix: 2157 passed / 0 failed / 5 platform skips

items.title: SQL inline constraint semantics: honour PRIMARY KEY fully, refuse the rest loudly
evidence: Pre-existing since audit: inline PK reaches catalogue; NOT NULL/CHECK/UNIQUE/DEFAULT/REFERENCES refused with actionable diagnostic (Option B)

New: conflicting inline vs WITH primary_key is refused (was: WITH silently won); multiple inline PRIMARY KEY columns refused with composite WITH form in the diagnostic; table-level constraints refused with the supported form named; inline PK canonicalised into the properties bag so it survives the catalog JSON round trip (was silently dropped on reload - real defect found during this work); upsert planning binds against an inline-only key
Mutation-checked: reverting catalog.cpp+ast_builder.cpp to pre-change semantics fails exactly the 4 new gate tests
items.result_revision: committed post-baseline (feat(sql): inline PRIMARY KEY is one honest declaration)

items.title: Reject unavailable connectors before deployment (local plan-time + cluster-authoritative submission)
evidence: check_connector_availability (src/cluster/connector_availability.cpp) gates Coordinator::submit_job before planning/allocation; availability read from the registries the job deploys against (bundle-aware), never a hardcoded list; message names the connector, this build's available source/sink connectors (capability registry) and the CLINK_WITH_* rebuild flag

Cluster-authoritative by construction: the gate runs in the submission-owning process (in-proc coordinator for clink run; target coordinator for POST /api/v1/jobs/spec and /jobs/sql); GET /api/v1/connectors already serves the cluster manifest to CLIs

8 tests in tests/test_connector_availability.cpp (missing connector, registry-decides/CLI-vs-cluster, runner-only registration, non-connector pass-through, always-built pass, longest-prefix vocabulary + boundary, vocabulary-completeness pin over declared capabilities, coordinator-level pre-deploy rejection) + SqlPhysical.ASourceOnlyConnectorRequestedAsASinkIsRefused pins the role mismatch; guarantee gate already pins unsupported exactly-once requests
Mutation-checked: gate call removed from submit_job compiles and fails the coordinator-level test; core label 2170/2170 green with the gate in place

items.title: Adaptive unaligned-checkpoint wiring: measured backpressure drives the existing resolver in clink's own runtimes
evidence: checkpoint::AdaptiveModePolicy (header-only): threshold + consecutive-window hysteresis both directions + bounded history + switch counter; deterministic, driven by synthetic pressure in tests

In-process wiring: CheckpointCoordinator::enable_adaptive_mode(pressure_fn) behind the existing set_mode_resolver seam; Dag::channel_pressure_fn() = max depth/capacity across runner input channels; trigger() emits clink_ckpt_mode_total{mode} and clink_ckpt_adaptive_switch_total

Cluster wiring: CheckpointAlignment::Adaptive; coordinator trigger sweep observes last completed checkpoint duration / interval and stamps TriggerCheckpointMsg.barrier_mode_plus1 (trailing wire field, 0 = legacy/static); DeployMsg.adaptive_barrier_mode (trailing, before the epoch per contract) makes sources forward the injected stamp instead of re-stamping; per-op overrides still win; lint covers Adaptive-without-periodic

Tests: 8 AdaptiveModePolicy behaviours incl. spike-no-switch and hysteresis both ways; wire round-trips + 3 tail-truncation compat shapes; mode-flip correctness rests on the aligner's per-barrier pinning proven in test_co_operator_unaligned
Mutation-checked: hysteresis mutant (switch on first pressured window) compiles and fails the policy suite; core label 2179/2179 green

items.title: Release qualification tooling: scripts/qualification/run.sh --ref <git-ref> with full provenance recording
evidence: scripts/qualification/run.sh --ref <git-ref>: detached-worktree build + suite + provenance (SHA, 87 build flags, compiler, 10 dependency pins, capability manifest, host, timestamps) into a retained per-run evidence dir; destroy.sh deletes a run's cloud resources by label
Demonstrated: PASS at 0199248a5f6b, 2180/2180 in 20 minutes, provenance.json + results.json retained
Its first invocation found a real defect: cmake/GitHooks.cmake aborted configure in any git worktree (.git is a file there), so every worktree build of clink was broken

items.title: Multi-day Kafka exactly-once failure campaign with independent oracle
infrastructure: Hetzner fsn1, run qual01-20260816: 1 ops (cpx42, also image builder + NFS export) + 1 coordinator + 3 workers (cpx32) + 3 Redpanda brokers (cpx22), EUR 0.315/h
Shared checkpoint state over NFS from the ops host - proven required: state is per-subtask under one dir resolved on each node's own filesystem, so a redeployed subtask on another host finds nothing
Qualification image built ON the rig at the commit under test, with CLINK_ENABLE_FAULT_INJECTION=ON

results.local_dry_run: harness proven end to end before any spend: 46,800 deterministic events, 1,137 committed output records, every judged window correct; mutation-tested by injecting a foreign record (caught, foreign=1) which exposed and fixed a verifier defect that reported 317 phantom missing results

functional_verification.first_fault: worker SIGKILL at checkpoint 341 while RUNNING, restarted 26s later
functional_verification.note: the campaign refuses to enter its soak until every one of these is observed; each was a step that had previously failed silently in some form

harness_defects_found_and_fixed: chaos controller polled a job status field that did not exist - would have applied zero faults
backgrounding over ssh hung the driver twice while the remote process ran happily
verifier reused a fixed consumer group - a re-run got a partial assignment and reported 317 phantom missing results
verifier required exact high-water position, unreachable on a live stream - deferred judgement forever
verifier stored a null offset snapshot when the group was still assigning - those windows could never be judged
campaign did not own its topics - a previous run's events made the oracle report 161,111 missing that were never its to produce

items.title: No silent transport downgrade (Postgres TLS assertion, Kafka SASL coherence)
evidence: Postgres: zero sslmode handling existed anywhere; libpq's default silently falls back to plaintext. Every connect site now asserts the established transport (PQsslInUse) - refuses when encryption was demanded, warns when unstated and unencrypted, records when encrypted

Kafka: SASL credentials with no security_protocol, and TLS material with a plaintext protocol, are refused before a byte reaches a broker; the passthrough cannot weaken a transport under configured credentials. 10/10 security tests

items.title: Worker task-thread handle leak; job status on the HTTP API
evidence: Finished subtasks were never joined until worker shutdown, holding an 8MB stack mapping each - invisible to a thread count. Reaped now; regression test asserts on the retained handle count (mutation: 2 handles after one job vs 14 after seven)
GET /api/v1/jobs/:id and /jobs gained an explicit status; the ops API previously exposed none, and the chaos controller's gate silently never fired
